explication: Up-For-Grabs is a website for discovering open-source projects with curated tasks for new contributors. In the beta Astro flow, project YAML is loaded and validated, build-time project data is exposed as JSON, then the browser fetches, filters, and displays results; visitors can search by text and recent activity. The tree also retains a legacy JavaScript listing flow with URL-based filters and pagination. The excerpts show the beta data path and parts of the legacy orchestrator; other legacy module behavior is described only at the level supported by the index or README.
